text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Take this, Teiooo!! A birthday present 
from Turbo!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, thank you! ...Wait, the color of this 
drink is looking pretty crazy, though.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ahem! It's Turbo's special blend, Rainbow 
Gaming Hachimi!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Drink this and you'll become the absolute 
best and strongest, in both games and 
races! Pretty amazing, huh?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, nice! The best and the strongest! 
Wait—are you sure you're okay with this, 
Turbo?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I suppose this is what they call sending 
salt to the enemy.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Umm... but still, it's fine!! Because 
today is Teio's birthday!! Turbo's gonna 
train more and get even stronger than the 
strongest!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I'll take down whatever Teio throws at me! 
Get ready!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, that's our Turbo! I'm ready to take 
your challenge anytime♪
